DRIVE-THRU DOCTOR

By: Nicky Troll | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
From sick notes to scheduled medication without scripts - a Benoni Doctor facing criminal charges continues to flout the law as he still illegally dispensing scheduled drugs.

Summary:
It seems Dr. Mohamed Ahmed has a chronic disregard for the law having already been blacklisted from a medical aid scheme, raided by the HAWKS, arrested and charged.

But his practice is STILL bustling – with runners even offering a drive-thru pharmacy set up to clients who park, order, pay and go without ever seeing the doctor or a pharmacist.

We go undercover and expose not only Dr. Ahmed, but take on the authorities that are either turning a blind eye or simply incompetent.


Further information:
TRACK RECORD
2013: Discovery Medical Aid Blacklists Dr. Ahmed was reported to the Health Professions Council of South Africa for allegedly prescribing medicine unnecessarily and then buying the same medicine back from the patient at a discounted price.
2015: Police raided his premises and seized a huge quantity of stolen medicine – he was charged.
2017: Hawks recovered more than two million rands worth of stolen medicine which was destined for state hospitals. Ahmed was arrested on charges of contravening the Medicines Control Act and the possession of suspected stolen medication

A HPCSA spokesperson said Dr Mohamed Amin Ahmed, of Actonville, near Benoni, was struck off the roll for medical aid fraud of R15 000 in 2003. Yet Dr Ahmed still has an active HPCSA number (MP 0228010 // 1459937) and dispensing licence from the Department of Health (GP04105D).

THE UNDERCOVER THAT’s BEEN DONE ALREADY

1. Buy from a runner in a drive-thru set up – we’ve done this twice
- the first time they asked the operative to get out and go in to see a lady that works there – she then gives the medication without a script, without seeing the doctor. We bought Duromine and Cytotec.
- The second time the runner and the lady came up to the car and did the deal by the car window. We bought Duromine and Cytotec.
2. Buy straight from pharmacy without script. We bought Tramacet & Metformin.

UNFORTUNATELY THE MEDICINE IS NOT GOVERNMENT MEDICINE AND NOR IS IT STOLEN
I think after the raid and 2017 and him being charged criminally, he stopped trading in stolen goods. I checked with the pharmaceutical companies – it’s not stolen. ( I think there is still potential for a different story looking at the black market for meds at a later stage)
ONE LAST SHOT AT GETTING THE DOCTOR ON CAMERA
3. Buy a sick note – we were told you have to pay to see the doctor now for a sick note – so we are going to go in and get an appointment with and blatantly say we’re not sick – we just need the leave. DOING THIS ON WEDNESDAY IF ALL GOES WELL OTHERWISE THURSDAY

WHAT WE HAVE
- CLEAR DRIVE BY PHARMACY – THE DISPENSARY IS IN THE DR AHMED’s NAME
- ILLEGAL DISPENSING OF SCHEDULED MEDICATION ON THREE DIFFERENT OCCASIONS
- THE WAY THE MEDICINE IS SUPPLIED IS ALSO ILLEGAL BECAUSE THERE ARE NO LABELS, NO INSTRUCTIONS FOR TAKING THE MEDS, NO DISPENSING LICENCE ON THE MEDS
- THERE IS A BIG CHANCE IF THEY ARE DISPENSING WITHOUT SCRIPTS, THERE WILL BE NO REGISTERS BEING KEPT – A LEGAL REQUIREMENT.

CASE STUDY
We have a recovering addict that will do a hidden identity interview – he has been going to Dr Ahmed’s practice for years to feed his addiction, buying discount scheduled pain killers and sleeping tabs for years – he will be able to comment on the fact that Dr Ahmed is highly regarded by the community because they think he is helping them oblivious to the fact that he is dealing in stolen meds.

It might be worth doing an interview with someone from SANCA – about the dangers of prescription medication addiction and the impact of irresponsible doctors and pharmacies.

PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR HIGHLIGHTING DR AHMED’s RUN INS WITH THE LAW
Will interview PI that has investigated Dr Ahmed for a medical aid previously and can comment on his MO and disregard for the law.

CONFRONTS
1. Dr. Ahmed
2. HPCSA – he has been criminally charged, he has been reported to the council and nothing seems to have happened.
3. SA Pharmacy Council – they are responsible for regulating the pharmacy / pharmacist
4. HAWKS – what happened to the case?


NOTES:
With 4 sets of confronts, and undercover elements – this story will need extra time. It promises to visually interesting, a classic bust and we will put the authorities on the spot. I’m just flagging it so long.



Extra Budget Items:
I feel this story qualifies for investigate rate in which case I will cover all the extra costs – but as this is only decided after the story is completed I would like to list the following costs upfront:

HOSPITAL INVESTIGATION – R2500
BUYING FROM DR AHMED AGENT – R1500 x 2 = R3000
COST OF MEDS - +/- R1000
TOTAL: R6500

Using agents to do the buys, we are one step removed from any questions about the legality. Unfortunately this is what it costs, these are discount rates for me because of my relationships with these investigators, they will provide me with invoices as always.

Press Release:


“Dr Drive-Thru”
He’s been blacklisted from a medical aid scheme, his offices raided by the Hawks and criminally charged, but it seems one doctor in Gauteng has a chronic disregard for the law. From issuing sick notes to healthy patients to illegally dispensing schedule five medication without a prescription or ever meeting the clients - this medical practitioner has become a one-stop shop for illegally accessing prescription pharmaceutical drugs. Carte Blanche goes undercover.
Producer: Nicky Troll | Presenter: Devi Sankaree Govender


Script:


FINAL SCRIPT

VO: Prescription medication addiction is a global epidemic . It often goes undetected, but the dangers could not be more real.

DAVID: I felt like it was not completely not a hard drug at all. I didn't even think of it as a drug. Int 1 m6 //

VO: This is a 26-year old recovering addict. His fix was Tramacet, a schedule 5 opiod based pain killer.

DAVID: Once I got A whole box that was like a highway ticket to hell. INT1 M8

LINK: It’s the sanitized version of drug addiction. It’s not a street drug, it is manufactured in a pharmaceutical lab and comes in proper packaging - how you get your hands on it is supposed to be regulated – here in South Africa, you can always make a plan.

UNDERCOVER UPSOUND
OPERATIVE: ek soek cytotec en ek soek duromine

DAVID: // whatever you needed. Everything has a price at Dr. Ahmed INT1 M9//

VO: Dr. Mohamed Ahmed runs a medical practice in Actonville on the East Rand of Joburg.

OPERATIVE It's a drive thru.
DEVI: Except you weren’t buying Hot wings.
OPERATIVE: not at all. INT1 M3


VO: During the undercover investigation – an operative bought scheduled medication from his practice on three different occassions.

First from the make shift pharmacy, then from the receptionist desk and finally from the car – we pulled up, ordered, paid and drove off.

LINK: These are not over-the-counter drugs…. This a schedule 5 pain killer, this is a schedule 5 diet pill with serious contra-indications if not taken properly, this a schedule 4 drug used off-lable for abortions. //

VO: All of that - without ever seeing a doctor… and without having a prescription…

OPERATIVE: . No questions. As long as I can get them the money, that's it. INT1 M28// selling medication that is the main aim //
DEVI: So very little consultation between doctor and patient going on.
OPERATIVE: There's no consultation Int2 M1

VO: Dr Ahmed is a licensed dispensing doctor. This means he has the authority to give patients medication. But there are rules and regulations explain Mlungisi Wondo from the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority or SAHPRA.

WONDO: The doctor have realized that you need these medicines // if he has a dispensing license. He'll keep the prescription and give you the medicines
DEVI: so it works like that. Consult. Prescription. And then dispense
WONDO: that’s correct
DEVI: the doctor is involved in all three.
WONDO: in all three if he has a dispensing license. SAHRA1 M8 END

VO: This, is not what’s happening at Dr Ahmed’s practice.

How scheduled medication is sold and dispensed is also regulated in South Africa. A prescription from a registered medical professional is required, a record of sale must be kept and the patient’s details must be obtained.

OPERATIVE: // people were coming in in and out buying Medicine from this room. I wouldn't even say it's a dispensary // nobody walked with a pre script or a doctor's note. INT1 M16

VO: Watch here, as the undercover operative buys a sheet of 10 Cytotec pills for R200 – more than double the retail price.

The seller is Hayley, Dr Ahmed’s receptionist – look how she takes out a packet containing the pills from her pocket.

UNDERCOVER UPSOUND
OPERATIVE - waar kry julle hierdie?
HAYLEY – die dokter

VO: It seems Dr. Ahmed and his staff have a chronic disregard for the law. In 2015 and again in 2017, the HAWKS and SAHPRA raided the practice.

Dr Ahmed has been arrested and criminally charged for fraud, the possession of suspected stolen medication and being in contravention of the medicines control act.

It time for us to pay him a visit. As we walked, we saw Hayley first.

DEVI: Howzit Hayley, Devi Carte Blanche ….do you have any cytotec, I know you got for me – you keep it in your in your broeks … we bought from you… //
HAYLEY: [staring ]M2 //BUT you saying I got it on my personal body that’s not the real truth…M5

DEVI: Have footage of you selling drugs to people, no prescription, nothing- unless maybe you’re a pharmacist and I don’t know
HAYLEY: me?
DEVI: Are you pharmacist.
HAYLEY: No, but I don’t know what you’re talking about… //
DEVI Does Dr Ahmed know what’s going on in his practice….
HAYLEY: No I don’t think so…M2 & M3

VO: That’s strange because in our undercover Hayley even sent a runner to get some of the medication from Dr Ahmed.

UNDERCOVER CLIP10 24 - 02.40
HAYLEY - Brandon hol gou op na die trappe – kry by die dokter ‘n box duromine. (gives him money)

VO: Hayley blamed Brandon.

DEVI: I got you on the undercover footage as well // Why you guys doing, //
BRANDON: looks agaaaaz…..
DEVI: Don’t look angaaz my friend – you know what I’m talking about.

VO: With Brandon dumbstruck. It was time to look for Dr Ahmed, he lives above the practice.

LINK: He is allegedly in the bathroom.
DEVI: Hi, how you? M9
D – is this a registered pharmacy, the answer is?
DA – this registered dispensing licenced – general practice…. l practi
D – you are not dispensing the medication, they don’t even see you // M15
M22
D – I’m talking tramatcet, duromine, cytotec- that’s what we bought, that’s how we know//
DA – the bulk of the patients are talking simple paracetemol for artiricithis –
D – so you helping people? how you helping with tramacet – hawks been here, come on doc
DA – no,no, pushing me in a corner
D – I’m not – I got footage //
DA - footage manipulated, that’s fact… footages are manipulated//

VO: Unfortunately for Dr. Ahmed, we don’t manipulate footage. Here is a clip of him committing fraud. Dr Ahmed sold a sick note to the undercover operative from the comfort of his own bed.

OPERATIVE – can I get a doctor’s sick note from you? CLIP 2 611 - 02.11
DA – for when?
OPERATIVE – tomorrow and Friday//
DA: What if I get in trouble?
OPERATIVE - I don’t know
DA: what sickness
OPERATIVE – I don’t know – I’m not sick // I want to go jolling tonight
DA: you want me to make up a sickness //something like a running stomach.
OPERATIVE – ja, something like gastro
DA – bring the red book. Give me R300 for that.
OPERATIVE – R300

VO: Cash handed over. Deal done.

DA – I don’t sell sicknotes
D – no, you did, I got it – 300 bucks //
// DA – this person said she was suffering from that sickness
D – no said joilling
DA – this person convinced me
D – she convinced you with R300

LINK: The Health Professionals Council of South Africa is tasked with regulating medical professionals – they are meant to uphold and maintain ethical and professional standards within the health professions. It seems they’ve slipped up with Dr Ahmed, because he appears to have slipped through the cracks for a good couple of years.

VO: The HPCSA declined an on-camera interview.

While the council previously found Dr. Ahmed guilty on two counts of fraud and imposed fines, he is currently facing internal charges related to the 2017 raid.

Despite these cases, his registration as medical practitioner is still active.

The council explained: “the current legal framework states that the HPCSA must follow its own investigations, finalise and pronounce on the outcome of the investigation.”

SAHPRA is tasked with regulating dispensing doctors’ practices, ensuring that they abide by the rules and that medicines are stored correctly.

DEVI: I understand why he's so confident. He's confident because nothing has happened since 2015
WONDO: The inspector that was involved in the right has never stopped monitoring. The challenge will have been we didn’t block the this is these sales from the wholesalers to him // SAHPRA2 M 23

LINK: This is where the medication was dispensed from – this not a pharmacy – look at how it looks, this is completely haphazard – medication should not be stored like this. BUST M34 PHARMACY LINK

D – It seems runs like spaza shop like bread and milk except you get prescripton medication.
DA – not exactly like that - //– I call them in to check them in small side room
D – my footage can buy through window – like drive trhu like a drive-thru
DA – without my consent –// nothing but dishonesty on the part of employees
D – passing buck // M13

VO: Dr Ahmed called Hayley to confront her.

DA – Hayley, you have doing things without me knowing because I’m suffering frm a chronic ailment – I’m not well – you beendoing funny things without my knowledge
D – is he right H – are you doing things without his knowledge
DA – speak the truth.did I give you consent for this behaviour – yes or no.
Hayley – NO

VO: Despite the blame game, we already know this is not the first time he has been accused of these exact transgressions.

Considering our investigation, HAKWS Spokesperson Col. Katlego Mogale believes Dr Ahmed is in contravention of this bail conditions.

COL: he is very arrogant in his doing.INT 1 M12// using the same practice number in the same license to continue
DEVI: and same M.O.
COL: in contravening the law.
DeVI: Well what does that say about somebody it is. He really doesn't care.
COL: And it also gives the public a wrong perception that this type of crime. The government is not serious about. INT1 M14

VO: This particular case is a collaborative effort between the police, the HPCSA and SAHPRA giving rise to some challenges explained Col Mogale.

DEVI: We’re sitting 2019 now why has there been this kind of delay. INT1 M9
COL: I think since 2015 there is some inroads that are being made with regards to the DPCI and the Department of Health.
DEVI: Not enough not enough.
COL: I'm not sure how much Enough is
DEVI: enough is when somebody like this gets put into jail because he is not only committing fraud he's breaking the law and destroying lives. That for me is enough INT1 M21
COL: // The other stakeholders need to also pull their weight INT1 M15 // at the end of the day we can go and re-arrest him and the system will give him bail and then we can go rearrest them which eventually It seems like now we are wasting time. INT1 M21

VO: SAPHRA has recommended that Dr Ahmed’s dispensing licence be revoked already in 2017, but a decision has not been reached.

DEVI: // What are we going to do moving forward now that I've told you what it is that we have.
WONDO: With the introduction of the new finding on your investigation yeah I will still want to call it an illegal pharmacy if there is that operation that we're going to look at immediately. we're gonna go back to the wholesalers that have sold medicines to him and // these accounts are going to be closed. //. It can be blocked immediately. SAHPRA2 M30 OR 31

VO: But for recovering addicts, Dr Ahmed and his illegal practice just needs to be stopped.

DAVID: I don't think he cares// INT1 // the foundation of his business is the people that have problems, that's what keeps his business lucrative. INT1 M18// M27


 
PROMOS
PROMO 1
VO: From issuing sick notes to healthy patients to illegally dispensing scheduled drugs, we investigate how one Gauteng doctor already facing criminal charges and continues to flout the law.

PROMO 2
VO: He’s been blacklisted from a medical aid scheme, his practice raided by the HAWKS, he's been arrested and charged - but it seems one doctor in Gauteng has a chronic disregard for the law.

PROMO 3
VO: We investigate one doctor’s practice in Gauteng offering a drive-through pharmacy where patients can buy scheduled drugs without ever meeting with the doctor or getting out the car.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): From sick notes to scheduled medication without scripts - a Benoni Doctor facing criminal charges continues to flout the law as he still illegally dispensing scheduled drugs.
metadata.Summary: It seems Dr. Mohamed Ahmed has a chronic disregard for the law having already been blacklisted from a medical aid scheme, raided by the HAWKS, arrested and charged. But his practice is STILL bustling – with runners even offering a drive-thru pharmacy set up to clients who park, order, pay and go without ever seeing the doctor or a pharmacist. We go undercover and expose not only Dr. Ahmed, but take on the authorities that are either turning a blind eye or simply incompetent.
metadata.Further information: TRACK RECORD 2013: Discovery Medical Aid Blacklists Dr. Ahmed was reported to the Health Professions Council of South Africa for allegedly prescribing medicine unnecessarily and then buying the same medicine back from the patient at a discounted price. 2015: Police raided his premises and seized a huge quantity of stolen medicine – he was charged. 2017: Hawks recovered more than two million rands worth of stolen medicine which was destined for state hospitals. Ahmed was arrested on charges of contravening the Medicines Control Act and the possession of suspected stolen medication A HPCSA spokesperson said Dr Mohamed Amin Ahmed, of Actonville, near Benoni, was struck off the roll for medical aid fraud of R15 000 in 2003. Yet Dr Ahmed still has an active HPCSA number (MP 0228010 // 1459937) and dispensing licence from the Department of Health (GP04105D). THE UNDERCOVER THAT’s BEEN DONE ALREADY 1. Buy from a runner in a drive-thru set up – we’ve done this twice - the first time they asked the operative to get out and go in to see a lady that works there – she then gives the medication without a script, without seeing the doctor. We bought Duromine and Cytotec. - The second time the runner and the lady came up to the car and did the deal by the car window. We bought Duromine and Cytotec. 2. Buy straight from pharmacy without script. We bought Tramacet & Metformin. UNFORTUNATELY THE MEDICINE IS NOT GOVERNMENT MEDICINE AND NOR IS IT STOLEN I think after the raid and 2017 and him being charged criminally, he stopped trading in stolen goods. I checked with the pharmaceutical companies – it’s not stolen. ( I think there is still potential for a different story looking at the black market for meds at a later stage) ONE LAST SHOT AT GETTING THE DOCTOR ON CAMERA 3. Buy a sick note – we were told you have to pay to see the doctor now for a sick note – so we are going to go in and get an appointment with and blatantly say we’re not sick – we just need the leave. DOING THIS ON WEDNESDAY IF ALL GOES WELL OTHERWISE THURSDAY WHAT WE HAVE - CLEAR DRIVE BY PHARMACY – THE DISPENSARY IS IN THE DR AHMED’s NAME - ILLEGAL DISPENSING OF SCHEDULED MEDICATION ON THREE DIFFERENT OCCASIONS - THE WAY THE MEDICINE IS SUPPLIED IS ALSO ILLEGAL BECAUSE THERE ARE NO LABELS, NO INSTRUCTIONS FOR TAKING THE MEDS, NO DISPENSING LICENCE ON THE MEDS - THERE IS A BIG CHANCE IF THEY ARE DISPENSING WITHOUT SCRIPTS, THERE WILL BE NO REGISTERS BEING KEPT – A LEGAL REQUIREMENT. CASE STUDY We have a recovering addict that will do a hidden identity interview – he has been going to Dr Ahmed’s practice for years to feed his addiction, buying discount scheduled pain killers and sleeping tabs for years – he will be able to comment on the fact that Dr Ahmed is highly regarded by the community because they think he is helping them oblivious to the fact that he is dealing in stolen meds. It might be worth doing an interview with someone from SANCA – about the dangers of prescription medication addiction and the impact of irresponsible doctors and pharmacies. PRIVATE INVESTIGATOR HIGHLIGHTING DR AHMED’s RUN INS WITH THE LAW Will interview PI that has investigated Dr Ahmed for a medical aid previously and can comment on his MO and disregard for the law. CONFRONTS 1. Dr. Ahmed 2. HPCSA – he has been criminally charged, he has been reported to the council and nothing seems to have happened. 3. SA Pharmacy Council – they are responsible for regulating the pharmacy / pharmacist 4. HAWKS – what happened to the case?
